text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening calls as of 0843 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.40 to C$1.10 a tonne higher on higher CBOT soycomplex calls and Saskatchewan Wheat Pool's crop output forecast for that province down at 20 million tonnes versus the 10-year average of 21.45 million tonnes. Technical resistance was seen in the November at C$364. November WCE canola crush profit margin fell to -19.20 Monday from -18.06 Friday. Canada's dollar opened flat at C$1.3885, rose to 85.07 yen and dipped to 1.3196 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$1.00 up on spill over support.
PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 higher on CBOT soymeal calls.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.10 to C$0.60 a tonne higher on CBOT corn calls with the beginning of harvesting capping gains.
FEED WHEAT - Steady with deteriorating crop conditions suggesting more feed wheat will be produced this year.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
